selected_evidence.requirement: Nginx serves a successful HTTP response at / on TCP 6700
selected_evidence.summary: Configuration shows port 6700 listeners, syntax validation passes, sockets listen on IPv4 and IPv6, and direct requests to the managed IP return HTTP 200.

selected_evidence.requirement: SELinux and firewall permit TCP 6700 persistently
selected_evidence.summary: TCP 6700 is labeled http_port_t and allowed by both runtime and permanent firewalld policy, including after reboot.

Healthy baseline boot ID a1be807a-f931-4328-b608-cd61f894ed55 was captured; systemd acknowledged the reboot; the new boot ID is fec0916e-c0d9-4610-baa6-2c9cd7833b20; afterward Nginx was active/enabled and returned HTTP 200 on port 6700.
